images.alt: View larger image: A dusty blue cropped puffer jacket featuring a high stand collar and zippered pockets is worn by the model. The jacket is layered over an off-white knit hoodie with drawstrings and styled with light gray drawstring sweatpants.

View larger image: The model is wearing a dusty blue puffer jacket, featuring a high collar with drawstrings and a cropped, voluminous silhouette. The jacket is layered over a cream-colored knit hoodie and styled with gray wide-leg trousers.
View larger image: The model is wearing a dusty blue puffer jacket with a high, voluminous wrap collar. The jacket is styled over a cream-colored ribbed knit hood that frames the face.

View larger image: A light blue-gray cropped puffer jacket is being worn by the model, who is adjusting its high collar with both hands. The jacket features front zippered pockets and is layered over a cream-colored knit top and gray sweatpants.

View larger image: The model is wearing a dusty blue puffer jacket featuring a high collar, snap-button front, and zippered pocket. The jacket is styled over a cream-colored knit hood and paired with light gray sweatpants.

View larger image: The front-facing cropped puffer jacket features a high padded stand collar, a concealed front zipper closure, and raglan sleeves. It is shown in a matte slate gray finish with two horizontal zippered welt pockets on the lower front.

View larger image: A gray padded jacket is showing its inner collar area, featuring a high, puffy collar with snap-button fasteners and a crinkled, matte-textured fabric. A white rectangular label reading "M O V E" and "H&M" is stitched onto the inner neckline.

View larger image: A grayish-blue textured fabric garment features the word "MOVE" in spaced-out, raised, tonal block letters across the center. The crinkled fabric shows a horizontal stitched seam running across the upper section.
